true_method_encoder.required_weight_history: BEATs trained with 10-s raw multi-cycle concatenation, 3-label Normal/Crackle/Wheeze BCE and patient-matching auxiliary loss
true_method_encoder.reason: AudioSet-only BEATs cannot be relabeled as a PC-MCL-trained encoder

trainable: 3-label auxiliary head where source labels support Normal/Crackle/Wheeze
patient-pair classifier where true patient IDs and repeated units exist
inspired_adapter.gradient_path: native, 3-label and patient losses share the trainable 256-d adapter
inspired_adapter.multilabel_missing_policy: explicit eligibility mask; masked_multilabel_bce; unknown entries never become negatives
inspired_adapter.patient_loss_weight_source: PC-MCL paper; official CLI default is 0.5 and enable_ssl is off unless explicitly enabled
limitations: pooled embedding pairs do not reproduce raw 10-s audio concatenation
HF date proxy is not a patient ID
KAUH B/D/E are filter views, not respiratory cycles
must be named PC-MCL-inspired rather than PC-MCL

true_raw_concat_followup.input: 10-s raw waveform formed by concatenating original native units before the frozen encoder
true_raw_concat_followup.cache_granularity: fixed pair/triple IDs plus the resulting 10-s encoder embedding, or on-the-fly frozen encoder forward
true_raw_concat_followup.not_equivalent_to: concatenating or averaging existing single-unit pooled embeddings
